title: Choose a winning tic-tac-toe move
description: You follow terminal checks and alternating max-min search on the supplied board.
source: draft: codex free model + edit: codex

steps.description: You represent X as 1, O as negative one, and empty cells as zero. check_winner tests row, column, and diagonal sums; actions lists empty indices.
You return terminal scores immediately. At an X node, an immediate winning move returns 1.0; otherwise the search keeps the highest child value and updates alpha.
You handle O symmetrically by taking an immediate O win or retaining the lowest child value. Each branch stops exploring when beta is at most alpha.

steps.question: Which empty index gives X an immediate diagonal win in the supplied position?
steps.answer: Index 6 completes the diagonal through indices 2, 4, and 6. The recorded search returns move 6 with value 1.0.

steps.description: You print the initial position, selected move, and resulting board. The final board places X in the bottom-left cell and completes that diagonal.
